name: Closer Than You Think
source:
Amelie enjoys the happy and carefree life of a teenager.

Favorite school, loyal friends and regular parties!

But everything changes in an instant ..

Amelia receives a strange letter.

It turns out that her family has nowhere to live, and they are forced to move to another city..

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/916710/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
艾美丽享受着幸福无忧无虑的青少年生活。

最喜欢的学校、忠诚的朋友和定期聚会！

但一切都在一瞬间改变..

阿米莉亚收到一封奇怪的信。

原来，她的家人无处可住，被迫搬到另一个城市。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/916710/]Steam[/url]]
